verdict.rationale: The only self-hosting signal is that Cloudflare's local simulator in workers-sdk is "powered by workerd", which links to a public cloudflare/workerd repo. That shows the Workers runtime can run on your own machine for development and testing. Everything else describes a managed service on Cloudflare's network ("No servers to manage"), and a community comment notes that managed bindings like KV and D1 make it hard to run the same code on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: first-party docs for self-hosting the runtime in production, self-hostable equivalents of the platform services (KV, D1, Queues, Durable Objects), and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
